title: How to Make the Gradient Mapping Small for Constrained Stochastic Min-Max Problems and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2609.08380v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the stochastic first-order oracle complexity for constrained or regularized convex-concave min-max optimization and stochastic monotone variational inequalities. We focus on the case when suboptimality is measured in terms of the gradient mapping, also known as, forward-backward or natural residual, an optimality notion that generalizes the gradient norm for unconstrained problems. In this setting, under standard unbiased oracle access with now-standard variance assumptions, the best-known complexity for making the norm of the gradient mapping less than $\varepsilon$ is $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$, compared to the near-optimal $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$ that is established in the unconstrained case. We bridge this gap to improve the gradient mapping complexity for constrained convex-concave min-max problems to $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$. translated_title: 如何使约束随机极小极大问题的梯度映射变小及其更广泛的问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了约束或正则化的凸-凹极小极大优化以及随机单调变分不等式的随机一阶Oracle复杂度。我们关注以梯度映射（也称为前向-后向残差或自然残差）来度量次优性的情形，这是一种将无约束问题的梯度范数概念加以推广的最优性度量。在此设定下，在标准的无偏Oracle访问和目前常见的方差假设下，使梯度映射范数小于 $\varepsilon$ 的已知最优复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$，而无约束情形下已确立的近最优复杂度为 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$。我们弥补了这一差距，将约束凸-凹极小极大问题的梯度映射复杂度改进为 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$。随后我们进一步推广，证明了同样复杂度对不具备有界（方差）等假设的更一般问题依然成立。
tldr: 该论文将约束随机凸-凹极小极大优化和随机单调变分不等式在梯度映射度量下的复杂度从 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ 提升至近最优的 $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$，并将该结果推广到更一般的问题设定。
en_tdlr: This paper improves the gradient-mapping complexity for constrained stochastic convex-concave min-max optimization and stochastic monotone variational inequalities from $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-4})$ to the near-optimal $\widetilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-2})$, and extends this result beyond standard assumptions to more general problem settings.
